name: meta-tagging platform - concept definition component
note: Every definition and every case carries the verbatim sentence it was read from, in one of seven cc-by papers acquired for this board. The builder refuses the whole board if one quote is not an exact substring.
license: CC BY 4.0 for the tag layer. Paper text is (c) its authors and is quoted here for identification under the cc-by licences of the seven sources.

cases.json.what: one record per case; `quote` is an exact substring of the paper

definitions.json.what: the rival definitions, their abstention right and their published score

verdicts.json.what: one string per definition, one character per case

how_to_score: Identical to art and game. Take every case whose status is P or N; SKIP any case whose verdict character is '-'; compare the character to the status; MCC = (TP*TN - FP*FN) / sqrt((TP+FP)(TP+FN)(TN+FP)(TN+FN)). The label-copy control must score +1.000.

abstention.what: Only a definition with may_abstain=true may carry '-'. Two do: criticality, whose own paper reports that the direction of a deviation is not recoverable, and the enactive account, which has no verdict to give about a system that is not moving in an environment.
abstention.the_catch: An abstainer is graded only on what it answered, so a high score over four cases says less than a lower one over eleven. The skipped count is published beside every score for exactly that reason.

calibration_rule.why_not_circular: For art, 'whatever people call art' is a tautology. For consciousness it is a substantive position - it is the field's default, and the Living Mirror account is expressly in the business of overruling it by counting every living system conscious.

limitations: Seven papers and 12 adjudicated cases. Every number here is over a corpus that small, and no confidence interval is reported because a seven-cluster bootstrap would be meaningless.

SEVEN OF THE NINE DEFINITIONS MAKE NO ERRORS, AND THAT IS NOT SEVEN CORRECT THEORIES. The cases that divide these definitions - a bacterium, a simulated brain, deep sleep - are the cases the literature cannot adjudicate, so they score nothing. The cases it can adjudicate are ones every definition already agrees on. Read this board as a measurement of how much the field can decide, not as a ranking.

Consciousness has no artworld. `art` works because an institution adjudicates its hard cases and a definition that excludes Fountain is thereby wrong. Nobody can rule on the bacterium, which is why the question is open.
Comparable only WITHIN this run. These numbers are not comparable with the art or game numbers - only the method is.
